featured_reviews.name: Aayush
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very good bookstore 👍 all the staff are really friendly and kind, now they have 2 bookstores near Virar Station (west), Bhavar bhai is always helpful.
You will get academic textbooks, digests etc for most courses, standards and boards along with non-academic books of different genres
I have been buying story books of self-help genre since a long-time drom Bhavar bhai (Shee Jagdish book depot) at really low price!
The best part is that they have a 50% return policy on return of second hand books if the book is returned in good readable condition for the next buyer (please ask for a receipt while purchasing any book if you wish you return after reading it!)
And if they don't have a book of particular genre then they usually order it for the customer withing 3-10 days...
Good trustworthy employees 👍
They reply on WhatsApp as well and you can ask for specific books on WhatsApp or at store directly anytime!
Overall, very good bookstore!
I recommend it to all school, college students as well as recreational readers 👍 because they sell most books at a comparatively lower rate than most other bookstores (discounted rate) and also provide return policy for secondhand books.
You can buy new book or second-hand book both depending on the availability

Always ask for a receipt on purchase of any book along with the date and price of the book purchased.

(PS :- I am a commerce student and I have purchased many textbooks, digests and non-academic books as well mainly of self-help genre, even if they don't have a particular book then they usually order it from their vendors depending on the availability, they have non-academic books of different genres like self-help, fiction, non-fiction, autobiography, biography, stock market, finance etc)

featured_reviews.name: pm
featured_reviews.review_text:
**★☆☆☆☆ — Rigid Policy, Zero Helpfulness**

I'm a CA Final student who visited this library multiple times requesting a new membership card — and was refused every single time. The reason? New admissions are only open at the start of the month.

So a student who needs to study today is expected to simply wait and waste days doing nothing. For someone preparing for a demanding professional exam, every day counts.

The librarian showed no flexibility whatsoever despite repeated requests. A public library exists to help people access knowledge — not to turn them away over a calendar date.

Fix this outdated policy. New memberships should be open any day of the month.

featured_reviews.name: Shalini Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Studying in this library has been challenging despite its good infrastructure. There are several serious issues:
1. The library is extremely expensive compared to others with fees of Rs. 2000 for non-reserved and Rs. 3000 for reserved seats.
2. There is no convenient parking space for vehicles. Visitors are directed to a distant paid parking area incurring additional costs on the students.
3. The Wi-Fi system is frustrating as you need to log in repeatedly. If you step out for 5-10 minutes, you have to log in again upon return.
4. Despite the high fees, the Wi-Fi can only be used on one device at a time, limiting access to either a mobile, tablet, laptop, or any other single device.
5. There are frequent water shortages in the washrooms.
6. The washrooms are often unclean and not up to the standards expected for the price being charged.
The library management should take this feedback seriously and improve their services instead of focusing solely on maximizing profits. Students may want to consider other options if available.
